title: OpenClaw Tech Brief
summary: As principais notícias de tecnologia, startups e pesquisa das últimas 48 horas, escolhidas entre dezenas de fontes.

lead.title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic say they will adopt a new standard that publishers can use to opt out of being scraped by AI across multiple crawlers
lead.summary: The new control will allow publishers to apply their AI training preferences across multiple crawlers.

news.title: Sources: Baseten is raising ~$2B in two tranches, one valuing it at $26B and the other at $30B; Baseten was valued at $13B in June after raising $1.5B
news.summary: Artificial intelligence startup Baseten is set to raise new funding that would more than double its valuation to about $30 billion, according to people familiar with the efforts.

news.title: A look at growing bipartisan opposition to AI data centers in drought-stricken Arizona, where TSMC's chip fabs were welcomed but newer projects face backlash
news.summary: Industry has drained the state's water reserves for decades. Data centers are the breaking point.﻿ — AA hulking gray giant rises from the desert.

news.title: How a Contractor’s Claude Agent Got Into the Pentagon
news.summary: This week on Uncanny Valley, we also discuss Anthropic’s IPO filing and the volunteers gearing up to counter ICE at the midterms.
news.author: Brian Barrett, Zoë Schiffer, Leah Feiger

news.title: An AI Agent Injected Drugs Into a Live Mouse’s Brain
news.summary: A biotech startup let an agent choose a gene therapy and successfully inject the treatment, offering a startling glimpse of the future of research labs.
news.author: Emily Mullin

news.title: How AI detectors like Pangram are changing human writing: authors drop em dashes, "not X, but Y" phrasing, and words like "delve", or add typos, to look human
news.summary: As AI transforms writing and detectors like Pangram police what counts as machine-generated …

news.title: John Ternus says Apple doesn't "want to ship AI for AI's sake" and that Tim Cook is "available to help wherever I ask" on policy; Ternus has yet to meet Trump
news.summary: Apple doesn't need fixing, and it doesn't want drama. Its new leader is a "product guy" who bleeds six colors.

news.title: S&P downgraded Meta's outlook from stable to negative, citing high capex and negative free cash flow; META fell 15% in October, its worst month in four years
news.summary: Meta's outlook has been revised downward by S&P Global Ratings on concerns surrounding cash flow and AI spending.

news.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
news.summary: When investors get nervous about AI spending, it helps to have the chipmaker that sells the chips offer to cosign the loan.
news.author: Aditya Mehta

news.title: Filing: Vancouver, WA-based Powerlattice, which makes a power delivery chiplet to reduce AI compute power needs by 50%+, raised $86M, after raising $31M in 2025
news.summary: Powerlattice, a Vancouver, Wash.-based startup developing chips that cut the power demands of AI processors, has raised $86 million, according to an SEC filing on Friday.

news.title: Binance says it has covered 90% of its hack losses, having set aside $6.34B+ of company funds; the remaining 10% is in less liquid tokens
news.summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance said on Saturday that it was able to cover 90% of the amount stolen during its recent hack.
